We are preparing for an upcoming event and would appreciate your assistance in evaluating availability and shipment timing. Please see the details below:

Best regards,
Danish Pastry

I hope you’re having a good week! We’re planning for a summer event at our main location and need to get a quote for a few items to make sure we’re covered. We’d like everything delivered by July 15th, as that’s when our prep starts. If possible, please include any info about bulk pricing or delivery options.

- 10 cases of Apples (we’re aiming for fresh stock, so please confirm if you can supply this quantity)
- 5 units of Kalamata Olive (Item No: AITEM-1005)

- 12 bottles of Soda - Large

Best regards,
Fresh HelloFoods

test_cases.name: Verbose, Impatient Quote Request with Explicit Shipment Date
test_cases.description: A verbose and impatient customer requests a quote for multiple catalog items, specifying a clear shipment date and providing extra context and commentary.

initial_turn.subject: Need Quote ASAP – Ship by June 20th
initial_turn.body:
I need a quote immediately, and please don't waste my time with unnecessary back-and-forth. For our upcoming summer promotion, I require the following items, and they must be ready to ship no later than June 20th. This is a hard deadline, so I expect you to confirm if you can actually deliver on time.

- 10 units of WonderWagon Bicycle
- 5 units of JoySprout Toy Car Set (make sure these are the standard ones, not any special edition—I don't have time to deal with surprises)
- 12 T-Shirts (I see several T-Shirts in your catalog, but you don't make it clear which is which—just quote me for the regular T-Shirt, not the generic one, unless that's the only option)

If you can't meet the shipment date, let me know immediately. Otherwise, send me the quote right away so I can get this approved. I don't want to repeat myself or clarify basic things that should be obvious from your catalog.

Sarah Johnson

Best regards,
Sarah Johnson
